rules: Totals are real elapsed time, floored. The breakdown uses wall-clock fields in the event zone with end-of-month clamping. A time in a DST gap moves forward by the gap; an ambiguous time takes the earlier instant. A date-only event counts to 00:00:00. timeZone null means viewerZone (UTC when viewerZone is null). Workdays count Monday to Friday by date. Auto shows hours and minutes below 48 hours.
